candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) when _owner is the zero address, otherwise return _owner (introduces conditional behavior differing when owner is zero).
Changed transferOwnership to allow transfer to the zero address (removed the require check).
Added an extra require preventing transferOwnership to the caller (owner cannot transfer to self).
Relaxed onlyOwner to check against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing who is authorized to call transferOwnership.
Tightened onlyOwner to require both owner() == _msgSender() and that owner is not zero address, preventing ownership actions when owner is zero.
